name: Daytona
description: 为 AI 代理提供云基础设施的平台,提供安全隔离的计算环境,让 AI 代理能够执行代码、使用软件工具和执行任务。支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS,通过单一 API 启动计算环境,资源可根据需求弹性伸缩
description_en: Cloud infrastructure platform for AI agents, providing secure, isolated computing environments where AI agents can execute code, use software tools and perform tasks. Supports Linux, Windows and macOS, enabling companies to launch computing environments through a single API with scalable resources
why_matters: 在 AI 系统从回答问题转向自主执行任务的趋势下,Daytona 解决了大规模运行 AI 代理的关键基础设施挑战。获得了 Anthropic、OpenAI、NVIDIA、Meta 等顶级 AI 公司采用,2026 年 1-9 月收入增长 25 倍,B 轮融资后估值达 10 亿美元,投资方包括 Stripe、Shopify、Datadog、Perplexity 等科技公司创始人
why_matters_en: Addresses critical infrastructure challenges for running AI agents at scale as AI systems shift from answering questions to performing tasks autonomously. Adopted by leading AI companies including Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA and Meta, achieved 25x revenue run rate growth from January to September 2026, reached $1B valuation with Series B backing from founders of Stripe, Shopify, Datadog and Perplexity
latest_news: 2026 年 10 月完成 6000 万美元 B 轮融资,估值达 10 亿美元,由 FirstMark 领投,Stripe、Quora、Shopify、Datadog、Perplexity、Zoom 创始人参投,累计融资 9100 万美元
latest_news_en: Raised $60M Series B in October 2026 at $1B valuation led by FirstMark, with participation from founders of Stripe, Quora, Shopify, Datadog, Perplexity and Zoom, bringing total funding to $91M
source_title: Daytona hits $1B valuation with $60M Series B for AI agent cloud

evidence.quote: Daytona, a company developing cloud infrastructure for AI agents, has raised $60 million in a Series B funding round at a $1 billion valuation, bringing its total funding to $91 million.

The round was led by FirstMark, with participation from Patrick Collison (Stripe), Adam D'Angelo (Quora), Brendan Foody (Mercor), Tobi Lütke (Shopify), Olivier Pomel (Datadog), Aravind Srinivas (Perplexity) and Eric Yuan (Zoom).
The company also reported a 25-fold increase in its revenue run rate between January and September.

latest_news_en: Announced €28 million funding round in September 2026 to pursue development and international expansion
source_title: Microsoft France ouvre les candidatures de la quatrième promotion du Microsoft GenAI Studio à STATION F - Source EMEA

evidence.quote: En septembre 2026, l'entreprise a annoncé une levée de 28 millions d'euros pour poursuivre son développement et son expansion internationale.
Arlequin AI, qui aide les organisations à exploiter de grands volumes d'informations pour éclairer leurs décisions, a renforcé sa plateforme avec l'appui de Microsoft et NVIDIA.

name: Matters
description: 一家基于人工智能的消费银行,通过AI顾问帮助用户更谨慎地消费和储蓄,并将银行通常保留的费用(如商店支付的卡费和货币兑换费)作为返现返还给客户
description_en: An AI-powered consumer bank that helps users spend more carefully and save more through an AI adviser, returning fees banks would normally keep (such as card charges and currency exchange fees) as cashback to customers
why_matters: 颠覆传统银行盈利模式,通过固定月费而非客户财务管理不善来赚钱,创始人曾成功创立并出售北欧消费贷款经纪公司Sambla,获得Klarna前COO等行业资深人士投资支持
why_matters_en: Disrupts traditional banking profit models by charging a flat monthly fee rather than profiting from poor consumer money management; founder previously built and sold Sambla to Nordic Capital, backed by Klarna's former COO and other industry veterans
latest_news: 2026年10月从隐身模式中走出,完成500万美元种子前融资,由瑞典天使投资人Jakob Johansson领投,计划申请牌照并在欧盟扩张
latest_news_en: Emerged from stealth in October 2026 with $5m pre-seed funding led by Swedish angel investor Jakob Johansson, planning to apply for licenses and expand across the EU
source_title: Stockholm startup Matters raises $5m pre-seed to build an AI-native bank

evidence.quote: Matters, a Stockholm startup building an AI-powered consumer bank, has raised $5m in pre-seed funding as it comes out of stealth. Swedish angel investor Jakob Johansson led the round.
He founded Sambla, a Nordic consumer loan broker, in 2014 and sold it to Nordic Capital in 2021.

name: Readily

latest_news: 2026年10月完成1100万美元A轮融资,由Define Ventures领投,Y Combinator和加州医疗保健基金会创新基金参与

name: ugo
description: 日本的人形与点检机器人公司，开发警备机器人ugo Pro和点检机器人ugo mini，并推出半人形机器人ugo Nova及物理AI开发平台ugo Physical AI Fabric，支持从数据收集到基础模型开发的完整闭环
description_en: Japanese humanoid and inspection robotics company developing security robot ugo Pro, inspection robot ugo mini, semi-humanoid ugo Nova, and the ugo Physical AI Fabric platform supporting the full loop from data collection to foundation model development
why_matters: ugo mini在日本点检机器人市场占有率第一，出货量超过100台，营收连续三年翻倍增长；其半人形机器人ugo Nova入选AIRoA国产通用机器人开发竞赛改良机开发阶段，单次充电可运行6小时，远超双足人形机器人的2小时；公司采用自主设计到量产的内制体系，累计融资达50亿日元
why_matters_en: ugo mini holds the No.1 market share for inspection robots in Japan with over 100 units shipped and revenue doubling for three consecutive years; its semi-humanoid ugo Nova was selected for AIRoA's national general-purpose robot development competition improvement phase, operates 6 hours per charge vs. 2 hours for bipedal humanoids; company maintains in-house design-to-production with ¥5 billion total funding
latest_news: 2026年10月21日宣布从瑞穗银行、横滨银行和日本政策金融公库完成总额10亿日元的债务融资，累计融资达50亿日元；同日在品川MIRAI ROBO SQUARE发布ugo mini G2次世代机型并展示Physical AI Fabric平台
latest_news_en: Announced ¥1 billion debt financing from Mizuho Bank, Bank of Yokohama, and Japan Finance Corporation on October 21, 2026, bringing total funding to ¥5 billion; released ugo mini G2 next-generation model and showcased Physical AI Fabric platform at MIRAI ROBO SQUARE Shinagawa the same day
source_title: フィジカルAIの社会実装と日本の勝ち筋　GROOVE X、Preferred Robotics、ugo、3社トップの講演とパネルディスカッション｜森山和道 ライター、書評屋

name: Vayo
description: Booking Holdings旗下第二家AI原生创业公司，通过连接用户邮箱自动整合旅行确认信息，管理完整旅程包括在Booking品牌外预订的行程，采用AI学习用户旅行习惯并主动工作的智能行程管理系统
description_en: Booking Holdings' second AI-native startup that connects to travelers' inboxes to automatically pull travel confirmations into a single system, managing entire trips including reservations made outside Booking's brands, with AI that learns travel preferences and works proactively
why_matters: 获得Booking Holdings计划投资1亿美元支持，作为独立绿地项目突破既有品牌约束，代表在线旅游巨头对AI原生旅行助手赛道的战略押注，通过邮箱集成和跨平台行程管理切入用户完整旅行决策链
why_matters_en: Backed by Booking Holdings' planned $100 million investment, operates as a greenfield project free from existing brand constraints, representing a major OTA's strategic bet on AI-native travel assistance by integrating email and cross-platform trip management into the complete travel decision chain
latest_news: 2026年10月14日在vayo.com启动私人测试版并开放候补名单
latest_news_en: Launched in private beta on October 14, 2026 with waitlist at vayo.com
source_title: Booking Holdings Plans to Fund New AI Startup Vayo With $100 Million - Skift

website_verification.title: Vayo. Where your trips live. Vayo

evidence.quote: Booking Holdings plans to invest $100 million in the startup, subject to continued advancement of the product and market conditions.
Vayo, Booking Holdings' second AI-native startup, launched Wednesday in private beta
It is built to become the place where travelers manage their entire trip, including reservations made outside Booking's own brands.
